 Mission
 Preparing the learner for knowledge society and
 strengthening socio economic base of the
 surrounding area through quality higher
 education


Vision
• To enlighten the learners with relevant
knowledge and equipping them for developing
their level of competence.
• To maintain healthy academic atmosphere
through effective teaching learning and
extension activities.
• To help the people of surrounding area in
social mobilization and the improvement of their
society economic base by involving them in
various institutional activities.
• To produce manpower for diverse field.
• To promote awareness on various issues such
as environment, human values, culture, human
right etc.
• To Establish linkage with various organisations
and Agencies is for overall upgradation and
development.
• To reduce social intolerance.


    PROSPECTUS 2025 - 2026                             PAGE 4
                       FURKATING COLLEGE (AUTONOMOUS)



                            Achievement of the College

        Accredited with A+ grade by NAAC in 4th cycle of assessment. 1st college
        of the state to get awarded by NAAC with A+ grade in 4th cycle of
        assessment
        Conferred autonomous status by the UGC on 2nd of June, 2023.
        Awarded 132nd, 130th and 122nd position by India Today, MORA in the
        year 2021, 2022 and 2023 respectively as the best college among Arts
        colleges of India.
        The college campus is a clean and green one and the college was awarded
        with "District Green Champion Award" for the year 2021-22 by Mahatma
        Gandhi National Council of Rural Education (MGNCRE)



                              Special Features
                      • Green Campus
                      • Ragging free environment.
                      • Tobacco free zone
                      • Friendly relationship with stakeholders.

                         Admission in the HS 1st Year for the session 2024-25 in Furkating
                         College (Autonomous) will be based on percentage of marks obtained

                         Candidates have to submit an online application through the online
     H.S. 1st Year
                         admission portal DARPAN and the college will strictly follow the
                         timeline of the portal.
                         The link for DARPAN admission portal--
                         https:1/studentcorner.darpan.ahseconline.in/login=
